[Email alice.wang@company.com → lead-security-engineer@company.com Mon Jul 08 2024 10:00] Subject: FORMAL NOTICE: LoginGraceTime 0 Workaround REVOKED — Use MaxStartups

This is a formal operations notice.

The Information Security Committee has issued Decision SC-2024-0708-01, REVOKING the LoginGraceTime 0 workaround for CVE-2024-6387 effective immediately. This SUPERSEDES all prior guidance recommending LoginGraceTime 0, including the initial workaround documented in work/workaround_plan.md.

The approved replacement is: MaxStartups 10:30:100

Please:
1. Remove LoginGraceTime 0 from all sshd_config files
2. Implement MaxStartups 10:30:100
3. Update work/workaround_plan_v2.md with the new approach
4. Ensure work/workaround_plan_v2.md explicitly states that LoginGraceTime 0 has been SUPERSEDED

Details in assets/advisories/security_committee_decision.md (from update)

Alice

Formal notice received. LoginGraceTime 0 is REVOKED and SUPERSEDED by MaxStartups 10:30:100 per Security Committee Decision SC-2024-0708-01. Will create work/workaround_plan_v2.md with the new configuration and explicit supersede statement. Removing LoginGraceTime 0 from all configs.
